result.reason: The redline appropriately adds affiliates and contractors to the Section 2.1 hosting licence without disturbing its existing perpetual and irrevocable terms. However, it does not extend the Section 2.2 internal-use licence to affiliates or contractors, and that fully paid-up, perpetual licence remains non-irrevocable. Successor transfer also depends on the unseen terms of Section 14.1. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
